verdict.rationale: Pilot is a managed bookkeeping and accounting service, so a ledger audit trail is a fair question for it. However, no evidence documents a who-changed-what-and-when audit log in Pilot's portal. Its use of the customer's QuickBooks account is a host-platform capability and earns no credit, and real-time account data in the portal is an adjacent feature, not an audit trail.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
